summary:
I wrote plan.md (not built or rendered yet). It puts four flat-roofed modern blocks on their footprints. KOMO East and West are white offices with horizontal window bands, cyan-glass curved drums and bows ringed in white with a flying-saucer canopy, and 14 white satellite dishes facing south: the KOMO broadcasting centre seen in the photo.
Hyatt House is a stepped diagonal wedge with beige and grey panels and regular punched windows over a glazed lobby, and a screened plant box on its roof. Aperture on Fifth is a block of dark and white panels with staggered glass-railed balconies over a row of glazed shops.
All blocks exist in 1.21.1. Floors are 5 blocks apart and doors sit flush at ground level. Each plot stays within its height: dish tops reach y 47 on KOMO East and y 45 on KOMO West.
